タックスファイルナンバー 申請方法 オーストラリア
TFN 何日で届く / TFN 届かない

competitors.what_they_have: The one to beat. '2026年最新' in the title, H2 '申請したのに届かない場合' with H3 causes (incomplete application, address errors), a '28日は待つのがルール' rule, ATO phone 13 28 61 with hours, a TIS Japanese interpreter section (13 14 50), a key-facts table (timing, cost, arrival, delivery method), a 5-step online application list, a 4-item FAQ (reissue, lost TFN, student visa, super) and a post-TFN flow table linking to tax return and DASP. Weak point: it says 'up to 47%' for no-TFN (wrong for WHM, who get 45%) and gives an unsourced '1 in 20 not delivered'.
Title with '【2026年版】' and '申請しないと給料から45%引かれる', a 5-row application step table, a first-person report, a 2026-27 rate table, and an H3 'TFNが届く前に働き始めてもいい？'. No FAQ and no phone numbers.

An 8-question FAQ with question H3s ('何日で届きますか', 'まだ届いていなくても働けますか'), a '必要なもの' checklist (passport, visa, Australian address), an H2 'TFN申請は無料？代行は必要？' with a scam-site warning, and 'ABNとの違い'. No official figures beyond 'up to 4 weeks'.

Covers the 'tfn 住所変更' intent: an H2 on changing the address (myGov or phone), an H2 'TFNが届かない時の対処方法' (name order, wrong address, call 13 28 61, interpreter 13 14 50) and 3 steps for working before the TFN arrives.
9 numbered screenshot steps of the ATO IAR flow (foreign passport holders > Apply online), the date-of-birth format, ATO 13 28 61 and the interpreter number. Screenshots date from 2020.

gap_summary: Every top-5 page answers four things that /ja/tfn does not show as visible text: (1) the actual application steps, (2) what to prepare, (3) what to do when the letter has not arrived after 28 days, with the ATO phone number and the free Japanese interpreter line, and (4) how to change the address while waiting. None of them has the 45% to WHM-rate mechanism right with an official source, and none offers a person who handles it. Our edge is accuracy plus a single WhatsApp step. The plan also fixes one accuracy problem on our page: the hero lede and FAQ 3 say pay is withheld at 45% 'until the employer has the number', which contradicts the ATO 28-day rule that our own guides state correctly.

facts.fact: Working holiday makers (subclass 417 and 462) in Australia with a work rights visa linked to their passport can apply online through Individual Auto-Registration (IAR). You cannot use IAR without a valid work rights visa.

No documents need to be sent to the ATO for an online application. The TFN is posted to the Australian postal address on the application, within 28 days of the ATO receiving the completed application. Do not lodge another application in that period; after 28 days contact the ATO with your receipt ID.
An employee who has applied for a TFN has 28 days to give it to the employer; after that the employer must withhold at the no-TFN rate (45% for a foreign resident).
Withholding where no TFN is on file for a working holiday maker: 45%. WHM rate 15% on the first $45,000, effective 1 July 2026 and unchanged from 2025-26.
It is free to apply for a TFN. A TFN is a unique number (usually 9 digits) and is yours for life, even if you change jobs or go overseas.
ATO individual enquiries 13 28 61, 8:00 am to 6:00 pm Monday to Friday; from overseas +61 2 6216 1111; TIS National 13 14 50.
An old or wrong address can be updated during the ATO call about a late TFN.
facts.source: src/app/(site)/tfn/page.tsx FAQ 'What if my TFN has not arrived after 28 days?'
